newsitem.title: UK: Moorfield to pursue Greycoat merger.
newsitem.headline: Moorfield to pursue Greycoat merger.

text.p: British property company Moorfield Estates said on Thursday it would seek to pursue merger talks with its larger rival Greycoat.

"Moorfield would welcome the opportunity for a constructive and confidential dialogue with Greycoat aimed at establishing common ground which could lead to a merger of the two companies and will seek to pursue such discussions," Moorfield said.

In a statement Moorfield said it had noted earlier comments by Greycoat. Greycoat's chairman Michael Beckett told an extraordinary general meeting that it asked Moorfield for "a full and detailed proposal" which he said it would consider carefully "if and when it arrives".
A resolution by rebel shareholders to break up Greycoat at the special meeting was earlier adjourned for three weeks so that the Moorfield approach could be looked at by the Greycoat board.
